findings: [61] Stray comma between subject and verb: «Светлогуб, почти желал мученичества» (Svetlogub, pochti zhelal, 'Svetlogub, almost desired'); translated without it.

[183] No comma before the attribution dash: «Должно быть, одной — улыбаясь, сказал Меженецкий» (dolzhno byt', odnoi — ulybayas', skazal Mezhenetsky, 'Must be the same — Mezhenetsky said, smiling'); punctuated normally in the English.
[228] Missing comma after the subject: «он избрав какую-нибудь эпоху» (on izbrav kakuyu-nibud' epokhu, 'he having chosen some epoch'); translated as if «он, избрав».

[271] Comma where a sentence break is required: «слова его бессмысленны, Так же думали» (slova ego bessmyslenny, Tak zhe dumali, 'his words were meaningless, So too thought'); translated as two sentences.
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. None of these readings affects meaning, so the unit is not held out of reviewed status; Confirm against the printed volume 41 at the next print-witness pass.
